# Spatiotemporal consistency
**Type:** Construct  
**Supporting papers:** 1  

## State of the Field

The quality of generated instructions being logically sound and correct with respect to the physical arrangement and temporal ordering of assembly steps.

## Sources

**Spatiotemporal consistency** (1 paper: [Evaluating Spatiotemporal Consistency in Automatically Generated Sewing Instructions](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.934.pdf))
> The quality of generated instructions being logically sound and correct with respect to the physical arrangement and temporal ordering of assembly steps.
